authorization.source: user approval of Scheme A as the G07-G09 prospective architecture plus standing autonomous continuation of the active research goal

implemented_contracts.canonical_identity: UTF-8 compact sorted JSON; content_sha256 is excluded from its own digest; duplicate keys and non-finite constants are rejected on load
implemented_contracts.skill_validation: exact field allowlist; five executable role contracts; direct semantic payload; provenance, fallback and claim boundaries; first-party path and byte-hash verification before import
implemented_contracts.library_validation: sorted skill identities; revalidation of bound skills; exactly-one router contract; verifier closure; endpoint identities; accepted/rejected ledger byte hashes; genesis or accepted transitions; parent and rollback object bindings
implemented_contracts.privacy: recursive rejection of request/response bodies, evaluator/reference answers, credentials, problem text and solver objective/point keys
implemented_contracts.anti_pointer: each semantic role must carry nonempty semantics and cannot be represented only by path/hash/URI/reference pointers
implemented_contracts.description_length: prefix-free length envelope over skill semantic payloads plus router semantic payload only; file paths, reconstruction hashes, outcomes and machine metadata are excluded
implemented_contracts.publication: content-digest filename, O_EXCL terminal ownership, O_NOFOLLOW where available, file fsync then directory fsync, no replacement; a crash-created partial terminal remains an explicit abandoned reservation requiring external audit
implemented_contracts.loading: repository-relative POSIX containment, no parent segments or symlink components, canonical byte equality, filename/digest equality, and full kind-specific revalidation
